llm_top3.reasoning: I deviate from the top-ranked names because BSX (rank 1) has clearly negative news flow (52-week lows, BofA target cut) and CG/EXE (ranks 2-3) are dominated by low-materiality 13F filings. TRGP has a genuinely transformative 20-year ExxonMobil midstream deal plus new 52-week highs; ROST posted a high-materiality beat-and-raise with 10% comps and accelerated expansion; SYF combines a raised-guidance earnings beat with a credible OpenAI agentic-commerce catalyst while still trading at a discount.
